name: 12_multi_series_router
description: One issuer, two live series: S1 (tier 2) and S2 (tier 1 split router + quarterly proofs). On-chain receipts pass through 100% until θ, then route r × units to the vault; routed amounts are credited against each quarter's proven payment (shortfall paid, excess carried forward, year reset). Issuance stop/resume gates new series only.

config.chainDomainNote: Bid/ask commitments, signed messages and the deployment domain depend on chain-specific wallet bytes and chain id; harnesses recompute them from the plaintext fields here (salts, prices, quantities, periods, nonces) and sign with the keys derived from `keys[*].seed`. Amounts, periods and ledger values are chain-independent.

steps.note: tier flags 1|2: on-chain split router (plaintext θ and r, the issuer's choice) plus quarterly proofs
both series settled: 400 units each at 105; r × units = 4% on each
existing series are unaffected by the issuance stop
50,000 below θ passes; 4% of 10,000 = 400 to the vault (fee 20); routerCredit 400
payment 400 fully covered by router credit → due 0
owed YTD 2,400, payment 2,000; credit 1,600 → shortfall 400 due
2026 gross on S2 = 4% × 120,000 = 4,800 (router 4,000 + issuer 800); holders got 95%
routerCredit still 0; issuer received the full 20,000
